name: Filtered Launchers
author: shander
description:
[h2]Two blocks in one: Launcher + Filter[/h2]
Drag it exactly like the vanilla Launcher (drag up/left/right to pick a direction) - but equip it and you get the game's own Filter configuration screen on the same tile. Only what you allow ever gets launched; everything else just stays put instead of flying out.

[h2]Filtered Launcher[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pairs with the plain [b]Filter[/b]: one resource at a time.
[*] Standard Launcher speed.
[*] Unlocked in Research once [b]Filter[/b] is researched.
[/list]

[h2]Advanced Filtered Launcher[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pairs with the [b]Advanced Filter[/b]: multiple resources at once, liquids and gases included.
[*] Launcher Mk2 speed (2x).
[*] Unlocked in Research once both [b]Advanced Filter[/b] and [b]Conveyors Mk2[/b] are researched.
[/list]

[h2]How it works[/h2]
Equip either block like you would its vanilla counterpart - the real Filter / Advanced Filter screen opens, same as always. Configure it, place it, and it only launches what you told it to.

[h2]Advanced Filtered Launcher actually launches liquids and gases too[/h2]
Unlike a vanilla Launcher (which only ever throws solid/physical material), the Advanced Filtered Launcher can launch liquids and gases as well, if the filter allows them - a real gameplay capability added by this mod, not just a filtering option. The plain Filtered Launcher, vanilla Launcher and vanilla Launcher Mk2 are all untouched and still only handle solids, matching the real Filter vs. Advanced Filter split.

[i]Built on the vanilla Launcher sprite, with a small bar + "F" mark added so it reads as its own block (red accents on the Advanced version).[/i]

affectsLiquidsAndGases.label: New Filtered Launchers Also Filter Liquids/Gases
affectsLiquidsAndGases.description: Starting value for newly placed (plain) Filtered Launchers, matching the vanilla Filter's own default (off - solids only). Advanced Filtered Launcher always starts with both on, matching the vanilla Advanced Filter, regardless of this setting. Only affects blocks placed after you change this; existing ones keep whatever they were placed with.
